title: CareTask
description: One scheduled care action as the Verdant mock API returns it (fictional demo data). The shape care-task-row binds; plantId references a Plant (plant-card.contract.json) by id. Derived fields are baked against the scenario's fixed fictional today (handoff/verdant/scenario.json's today) — committed demo data stays coherent forever.

plantId.description: id of the plant this task belongs to

plantName.description: denormalised for display — the row renders without fetching the plant

done.description: already logged in the scenario's history; done tasks carry status "ok" and stay out of the Today list

status.description: derived from due vs the scenario's fixed fictional today

x-derived.rule: done is true: ok. Otherwise compare due with today as calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD): due before today is overdue, due equal to today is due, due after today is ok.
